caption: The drawing shows two objects on a plain off-white background: an upper glass jar with a rounded body and a metallic lid, and below it, a circular metallic object seen from above. The glass jar is rendered in a light green transparent color with reflective highlights and a metallic lid that has a dark, shiny surface and a small knob on top. The metallic lid features several circular holes, suggesting it functions as a shaker. Below the jar, the circular metallic object appears to be the top view of a similar or the same lid, painted in dark brown or black with clustered holes at the center. Both objects are centrally aligned vertically on the page. The drawing is realistic and detailed with careful shading to suggest shape and light. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature: "G. Halpin."
title: Salt Cellar
